lens.adaptation: Ceiling, darkness, carried light. The jade-eye monkeys conceal themselves and their stone bodies come apart.

commands.text: Below the passage the cave opens into a stone forest. I could not see the ceiling from the floor. I went back for a light before I went in, which is the whole lesson of this place.
Pillars, as far as the light reaches, and the light does not reach the ceiling. Somewhere above, something changes position against the stone.

Jade-eye monkeys. They conceal themselves against the pillars and their bodies come apart into stone when they are finished. Jade Skin held. Went in twice more to learn the pillars rather than the monkeys.
